It then normalizes the directory structure by moving files up from subdirectories and sets standard permissions. These operations are confined to the package build environment and do not affect the host system at install time. No obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, or dangerous commands are present.

The package depends on `aimp`, which is expected, and includes no scripts or binaries beyond the skin assets. The maintainer script is transparent and follows common conventions for skin packages. While the source URL is not a direct static link, it is from the official AIMP community site and consistent with how AIMP skins are distributed. There is no evidence of supply-chain tampering or malicious behavior.
</details>
